targets.adjudication_verdict: INSTRUMENTATION FAILURE (fourth in the lineage), NOT a contributory negative -- recommend NON_CONTRIBUTORY, overriding the driver's pre-registered FAIL->weakens branch. What the run genuinely established: the 862a cluster autopsy's prescription worked (P1' 3/3, P2 3/3+3/3, preflight, non-degenerate; the manipulation touched the targeted stream for the first time). What the red-team pass established and this session independently re-verified: the C3 discrimination bar (|rho| >= 0.3 between pe and ||bias||) was ARITHMETICALLY UNREACHABLE via the pre-registered mechanism -- pe's maximum attainable variance share of ||bias|| is <= 1e-6 in every cell (max direct-path |rho| ~ 0.001), because the pe-scaled EVC effort term (0.5*0.1*pe*10 per candidate) is drowned by E3-score payoff components ~500-1800. A pre-registered branch cannot rescue a criterion incapable of firing; that is exactly the precedent this lineage set at 862a, where the same FAIL->weakens branch was overridden to non_contributory by the confirmed cluster autopsy. Secondary, independently sufficient concern: the realized manipulation dose was ~10x below the calibration's predicted 15-20% sub-threshold minority (holds 0.1-2.9% of steps; eval-phase V_s sat almost entirely inside the 0.995-0.999 dead band -- a warmup-vs-eval distribution shift the calibration probe, run on pooled ticks, could not see), and ON-vs-OFF bias series correlate at 1.0000. The declared null ('coupling not detectable at this harness's scale/design') is literally true -- but because the DV is structurally insensitive, it carries no evidential weight against the coupling. Q-040.c remains untested.

learning_extracted: The 862a cluster autopsy's prescription worked exactly as written (calibrated per-stream threshold + stream-specific P1' converted a self-deceiving manipulation into a demonstrably-engaged one) -- and the next-level lesson is its own generalisation: a discrimination criterion needs an ARITHMETIC REACHABILITY check on its DV at authoring time. Twenty lines of python over any pilot manifest (bound the pe-attributable variance share of the DV) would have shown |rho| >= 0.3 was unreachable before spending 110 minutes x 6 cells. Same family as 862a's lesson (preconditions must assert engagement of the specific slice the DV consumes), one level up: the DV must be shown CAPABLE of expressing the effect, e.g. via the pe-isolated bundle readouts that already exist (dacc.py:460-461).

A calibration probe must sample the phase it calibrates for: the 0.995 threshold was calibrated on pooled warmup+eval ticks, but eval-phase V_s(z_harm_a) sat almost entirely inside the 0.995-0.999 dead band (refresh counters 1/133/120 over 775/1962/1088 steps), collapsing realized dose to 0.1-2.9% against a predicted 15-20%. Future gating experiments should calibrate on eval-phase ticks under agent.eval() AND assert a minimum realized-dose precondition (holds as a fraction of steps), not just holds > 0.

A pre-registered FAIL->weakens branch cannot rescue a criterion that was arithmetically incapable of firing -- pre-registration fidelity governs interpretation of a FAIR test, not the fairness of the test itself (the lineage's own 862a precedent, reapplied).

The ON arm's dominant realized manipulation was z_beta holds (190/1962, 190/1088 via the retained 0.85 global threshold), not z_harm_a -- empirically immaterial here (bias series ON/OFF correlation 1.0000) but a live confound for any dose-corrected successor, since z_beta feeds E3 commitment dynamics -> payoffs -> the DV's dominant component.
